author: Ruby Dev SRL
description: BroHub is the shared admin shell: one mount point, one layout, one sidebar and one place to configure who is signed in. Each Bro gem registers its pages and shows up as a section. Sections only appear for people who may use them.

author: Ruby Dev SRL
description: Records Rails console sessions (who, why, what), asks for a justification before sensitive data is touched, blocks tampering and risky methods, and ships a mountable engine where auditors review sessions. One gem instead of console1984 plus audits1984.

author: Erick Guan
description: A Magnus companion providing JiffTimezone constructors and bundled IANA timezone data for Ruby Time.

author: Ruby Dev SRL
description: A BroHub section that shows what DeadBro knows about this app (overview, endpoints, errors, slow SQL, findings, deploys) next to the other Bro gems. It reads from DeadBro with the API key the dead_bro gem already uses, and shows whether the gem itself is healthy.

author: FlightByte
description: Look flights up, watch them with signed webhooks and verify every delivery. Flights, subscriptions, countries and a Rack webhook receiver, with no dependencies outside the standard library.
